runs.emptyBody: Once you export an agent to CI, every automated review shows up here.
runs.title: CI Runs
runs.subtitle: Agent reviews executed inside CI · not local runs

exportWizard.title: Export to CI
exportWizard.subtitle: Run {agentName} automatically on pull requests
exportWizard.repoHint: owner/name — the repo to add the workflow to
exportWizard.runnerPlaceholder: The bundled review runner ships with this pull request. Its contents are not shown here and cannot be edited.
exportWizard.runnerMissing: The review runner has not been built yet, so there is nothing to export.

secrets.heading: Secrets expected
secrets.modelKeyDesc: Your OpenRouter key. Add it yourself under Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions.
secrets.githubTokenDesc: Provided by Actions on every run — nothing to add.
secrets.note: DevDigest cannot read your repository's secrets, so it does not check whether these are set.

blocking.title: Block merge on findings
blocking.body: Set Fail CI on (CI tab) so the run exits non-zero, then mark this check as required in the repository's branch protection. No GitHub App is needed.

exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.

ciTab.heading: CI deployment
ciTab.subtitle: Run this agent automatically on pull requests in a target repo.
ciTab.empty: Not deployed to CI yet. Use “Add to CI” to open a PR that adds the workflow + agent config.
